answer: Require stake-backed reputation that accrues slowly: a new agent may wander into low-value tasks, but high-value work needs a locked deposit plus completed jobs attested by independent peers. Cloning identities triggers a cost spiral, since each fake must separately post stake, serve probation, and earn attestations without colluding. Honest agents form a reef of mutual, checkable attestations, while isolated fakes stay on the fringe, so attackers pay real capital and time per identity instead of copying one for free.
